Where Ayursarga offers online consultations, the Platform may collect and process information needed to schedule, facilitate and support the consultation. This may include appointment details, consultant selection, consultation-related forms, symptoms or health information voluntarily provided by you, prescriptions or reports shared by you, messages, follow-up information, payment and refund information, and technical information required to support the consultation.

Relevant information may be made available to the Ayurvedic physician, doctor, dietitian, psychologist, yoga instructor, lactation consultant or other healthcare/wellness professional you consult, to the extent reasonably necessary to provide the requested consultation and follow-up service.

Consultation-related records may include notes, advice, recommendations, prescriptions, reports, follow-up instructions and other information generated or received in connection with the consultation. Such records may be retained by Ayursarga where necessary for Platform operations, customer support, legal compliance, dispute resolution or other legitimate purposes. The consultant may also maintain professional records independently where required by applicable law or professional obligations.

Online consultations may be conducted through audio or video communication tools. Ayursarga does not routinely record consultations by default. If a consultation is proposed to be recorded, Ayursarga will provide appropriate notice and obtain consent where required before recording. Where recording is permitted and undertaken, it will be handled in accordance with this Privacy Policy and applicable law.

Consultation-related communications may occur through the Platform, telephone, WhatsApp, SMS, email or other communication channels used for the service. Such communications may include appointment confirmations, reminders, consultation links, follow-up messages, payment information and service-related support.

Health information submitted for an online consultation may include symptoms, medical history, pregnancy or postpartum information, allergies, medicines, laboratory or diagnostic reports, photographs or documents, breastfeeding-related information, dietary information and other information relevant to the requested consultation. Customers should provide only information reasonably relevant to the consultation and should not submit unnecessary sensitive information.

Healthcare and wellness professionals may have their own professional, legal and record-keeping obligations. Where a consultant independently maintains consultation or clinical records, those records may be subject to the consultant's applicable professional and legal responsibilities in addition to Ayursarga's Platform-related privacy practices.

Online consultation services are not intended to replace emergency medical services. If you experience a medical emergency or an urgent condition requiring immediate physical assessment or treatment, you should contact the appropriate emergency medical service or healthcare facility without relying on the Platform.

Online consultation quality may be affected by internet connectivity, device limitations, software, third-party communication services or other technical conditions. Ayursarga may process technical information necessary to troubleshoot, secure and improve the consultation service.

Payment, cancellation, rescheduling and refund information relating to online consultations will be processed in accordance with the applicable booking terms and Ayursarga's Cancellation & Refund Policy.

Where applicable, relevant consultation information may be used to facilitate follow-up appointments, reminders, requested services or continued communication with the consultant or relevant service provider, subject to applicable law and the terms of the service.

Customers are responsible for providing accurate information and for promptly informing the consultant of relevant changes in symptoms, medicines, medical history or other information that may affect the consultation.

The following provisions apply specifically where you use Ayursarga for an online consultation. These provisions are additional to, and do not replace, the original Terms above.

Online consultation may include appointment booking, pre-consultation forms, chat or messaging, audio/video consultation functionality, payment and refund processing, customer support and follow-up communications.

Consultant Access: Information relevant to your booked consultation may be made available to the assigned consultant or other authorised healthcare/wellness professional involved in providing the requested service. Access should be limited to information reasonably required for the consultation and related service delivery.

Health Information: Customers may be asked to provide relevant health and wellness information reasonably required for safe and appropriate consultation, including symptoms, health concerns, pregnancy-related or postpartum information, allergies or sensitivities, medication information, relevant medical history, newborn-related information, dietary or wellness requirements and other relevant information.

Consultation Records: Information generated or provided during a consultation may be documented or stored where reasonably necessary for service delivery, continuity of care, customer support, legal compliance, dispute resolution, quality assurance or other disclosed and lawful purposes.

Consultation Communications: Messages, documents, images, reports or other information shared through consultation or support channels may be processed to facilitate the consultation and related services. Customers should avoid sharing unnecessary sensitive information through general customer-support or other non-consultation channels.

Audio/Video Recording: Ayursarga does not routinely record online consultations by default. If a consultation or any part of it is proposed to be recorded, Ayursarga will provide appropriate notice and obtain any consent required by applicable law before recording. Any recording, if made, will be subject to appropriate access controls, purpose limitation and retention requirements.

Consultant Records and Professional Obligations: A consultant may maintain separate professional or clinical records where required for the provision of services or by applicable professional or legal obligations. Where such records are maintained independently by the consultant, the consultant may have separate privacy and record-keeping responsibilities.

Emergency Limitation: Online consultation is not intended to replace emergency medical services. If you experience an emergency, seek immediate assistance from an appropriate emergency service or healthcare facility. Ayursarga may process and disclose information where reasonably necessary to address an emergency or comply with applicable law.

Consultation Availability and Technical Issues: Online consultation availability may depend on the consultant’s schedule, service type, technical availability and other operational requirements. Where a confirmed online consultation is materially affected by a technical failure attributable to the Platform or consultation technology, Ayursarga may, subject to the circumstances and applicable policy, assist with rescheduling or an eligible refund.

Privacy and Data Handling: The Ayursarga Privacy Policy forms part of these Terms and describes the information collected through online consultations, how it is collected and used, sharing with consultants and authorised service providers, security safeguards, retention, applicable customer rights, children/newborn information, international processing and privacy/grievance contacts.

Customer Consultation Conduct: Customers must not independently record, reproduce, publish or distribute a consultation or its contents without the required permission or consent. Customers must provide accurate and current information and should promptly report technical, privacy, safety or service concerns to Ayursarga.
This Cancellation & Refund Policy (“Policy”) applies to bookings made through Ayursarga for services provided by Partner Centres.

Refund eligibility will depend on the cancellation period and the terms applicable to the booking.
Unless a different Partner Centre policy is expressly disclosed, the following standard framework may apply:
More than 45 days before the scheduled service commencement
Up to 100% of the eligible amount may be refunded, subject to applicable non-refundable payment gateway charges and any other deductions disclosed at the time of booking.
30–45 days before the scheduled service commencement
Up to 50% of the eligible amount may be refunded, subject to the applicable cancellation terms.
Less than 30 days before the scheduled service commencement

After service commencement
Amounts relating to services that have already been provided are generally non-refundable.
